title: The last Inca ruler Tupac Amaru is executed in Cusco
summary: Tupac Amaru, ruler of the Neo-Inca State of Vilcabamba, was captured by Spanish forces and beheaded in the main square of Cusco.
reason: Viceroy Francisco de Toledo was determined to end the independent Inca state in the mountains.
significance: It ended the last independent Inca state.
